series_name: AC-800 (Fig. 3, visible markers; per-marker ROI runs)

isolation.region_basis: one explicit 9x9 px ROI per marker (see per_marker_runs)

extraction.aggregation: centroid of each connected marker after a 0-px opening

row_hint.notes: Digitized with digitize_figure.py v2.1; §3.4 step 6 check passed at 19.9786.

bundle_note: Bundle of 18 runs of scripts/digitize_figure.py extract --mode markers, one run per plotted marker, each with a small ROI (9x9 px) centred on that marker, colour #000000 tolerance 225, --open-px 0, marker size 4-400 px (6-400 for marker 1 of Zr-CDC). All markers of Fig. 3 are black and hollow and joined by black lines, so a whole-plot colour isolation cannot separate markers; per-marker ROIs were used instead. Each run archive is kept verbatim in per_marker_runs; series[] lists their points in pressure order. Every visible marker is the coincident adsorption and desorption markers of the run (the paper states the isotherms are reversible); the centroid therefore lies between the two branches where they are offset.

extraction.aggregation: centroid of each connected marker after a 0-px opening
